name: ~MIYAKO~ Awayuki no Utage
original_name: 雅恋～MIYAKO～あわゆきのうたげ
source:
A fandisc for the original MIYAKO game. Izumi holds a party for the shigoryou and shocks everyone by saying he’s disbanding their group. He also trusts Sangou with the mission of collecting magical shells to become a better shikigami.

[edited from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/05/13/otome-game-review-miyako-awayuki-no-utage/]Hinano's post[/url]]
translation:
原作《雅恋～MIYAKO～》的Fan Disc。和泉为四御寮举办宴会，却宣布要解散众人，令所有人大吃一惊。他还把搜集魔法贝壳、成长为更优秀式神的任务交给式神三号彩雪。

[根据Hinano的[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/05/13/otome-game-review-miyako-awayuki-no-utage/]文章[/url]修改]
